test_title: PYST 59: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3500

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per year

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (3500 × 6 × 6) / 100

⇒ SI = 126000 / 100

⇒ SI = ₹1260

**The simple interest is ₹1260.**
